WorkExperience.intranet_desc_0: Contributed to defining the backend architecture of a new solution and actively develop it with Node.js, TypeScript and Fastify.
WorkExperience.intranet_desc_1: Resolved race conditions in the event registration system using transactions and pessimistic locking in MySQL, ensuring isolation between concurrent transactions and eliminating duplicate records.
WorkExperience.intranet_desc_2: Contributed to refactoring a legacy system, migrating it to a modern stack with a Fastify API and a Next.js frontend, containerized with Docker and integrated with AWS services (Lambda, DynamoDB, Secrets Manager, ECS, CloudWatch, S3, ECR).
WorkExperience.intranet_desc_3: Cut the application's Docker image build time by 60% by configuring Kaniko layer caching on Amazon ECR.
WorkExperience.intranet_desc_4: Led the rebuild of the CMS powering shopping mall client sites, defining a modular layered architecture with Next.js, TypeScript and Kysely on MySQL, improving maintainability and scalability.
WorkExperience.intranet_desc_5: Implemented on-demand revalidation in the new CMS, triggered by webhooks on Vercel, cutting ISR costs and keeping site content always up to date.
WorkExperience.intranet_desc_6: Designed and built a page builder module for the CMS, allowing clients to compose custom landing pages from a versioned, Zod-validated schema, with type-safe server actions via ZSA and editor state managed with Zustand.
WorkExperience.intranet_desc_7: Built nine web applications from scratch with Next.js, React and TypeScript, including three multi-tenant ones, focused on performance (SSR/ISR, SEO), and maintained over 20 shopping mall websites in production on Vercel, serving thousands of daily users.
